attr.title: Sin and Punishment
attr.desc: Native static recompilation of Treasure's Nintendo 64 rail shooter Sin and Punishment featuring a custom OpenGL ES 3.0 renderer, widescreen support, and dedicated stickless and twin-stick handheld controls.
attr.inst: Copy your legally obtained Sin and Punishment Nintendo 64 ROM (.z64, .n64, or .v64) into ports/sinandpunishment/roms/ before launching. Optional translation patches (.bps, .ups, .ips, .xdelta) placed in roms/ will be applied automatically on first boot.
